display.purpose: Home statements and the largest page introductions.

label.purpose: Navigation, metadata, filters, and preview tools.

shadows.name: catalogue-preview
shadows.purpose: Lift the nested template miniature from its muted preview canvas.

motion.name: base-duration
motion.purpose: Shared theme duration for interface motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Forced animation and transition duration when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The compact default action for registry examples and product controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); padding: 10px 16px; font: 500 14px var(--font-interface); transition: filter var(--motion-duration); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .45; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A low-emphasis action that holds its place with a hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); padding: 10px 16px; font: 500 14px var(--font-interface); transition: background var(--motion-duration); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A full-width, warm-white text field for catalogue forms and search.
components.css: .ds-input-label { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--foreground); font: 12px var(--font-interface); } .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); padding: 8px 12px; font: 14px var(--font-interface); caret-color: var(--primary); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: .5; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The flat, bordered container for structured content and component demonstrations.
components.html: Good foundations.Useful, calm, and ready to extend.
components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); padding: 24px; font: 14px var(--font-interface); } .ds-card span { color: var(--muted-foreground); }

components.name: Badge
components.description: A compact muted pill for quiet classification and metadata.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--muted); color: var(--foreground); padding: 4px 10px; font: 500 12px var(--font-interface); }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: A compact, calm link that gains a muted surface only on hover.
components.html: ComponentsBlocksTemplates
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav a { display: block; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--foreground); padding: 8px 12px; font: 14px var(--font-interface); text-decoration: none; transition: background var(--motion-duration); } .ds-nav a:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Switch
components.description: A small pill switch used in the live playground and component forms.
components.css: .ds-switch { box-sizing: border-box; display: block; width: 44px; height: 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary); padding: 2px; } .ds-switch span { display: block; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--background); transform: translateX(20px); transition: transform var(--motion-duration); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: A flat bottom-border tab row that marks the active view in olive charcoal.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-tabs button { border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); padding: 12px 16px; font: 14px var(--font-interface); } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected="true"] { border-bottom-color: var(--primary); color: var(--primary); } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: -2px; }

narrative.overview:
Jez UI makes a generous, warm-white work surface for building interfaces, then interrupts it with concentrated mineral colour and a few playful moving exhibits. The catalogue stays calm enough to scan: ink typography, hairline divisions, roomy grids, and compact controls make the product source easy to assess.

Expression is deliberate rather than ambient. The home exhibit is the place for expressive ribbons, olive-charcoal controls, motion, and dark stages; documentation and component inventory return to quiet surfaces.
keyCharacteristics: Warm white paper and near-black ink establish the default reading environment.
Space Grotesk gives headings a large, close-set editorial voice; Geist keeps controls and supporting copy direct.
Soft sage and olive charcoal identify interaction, selection, and the live exhibit rather than filling whole screens.
Borders and tonal surface changes organize information; shadows appear only on contained previews and elevated overlays.

rules.name: The Concentrated Signal Rule
rules.body: Use olive charcoal and soft sage at moments that need direction or energy. Let the warm-white and ink system do the reading work everywhere else.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Space Grotesk for headings only. Keep UI controls, navigation, code, and supporting text in Geist unless a component explicitly needs a different functional face.

rules.name: The Quiet Frame Rule
rules.body: Keep durable content aligned to the shared shell and let the exhibit, preview canvas, or template artwork provide the visual event inside it.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Give ordinary cards and controls their boundary with colour and a one-pixel border. Reserve elevation for overlays and nested previews that need to read as above their context.

dos: Do use the warm-white, ink, and hairline-stone foundation for catalogue, documentation, and component previews.
Do reserve soft sage for highlights, selection, or a deliberate exhibit panel, and olive charcoal for active controls and direct action.
Do keep display type in Space Grotesk with close tracking and use Geist for interface work.
Do retain the shared focus treatment on every interactive primitive.
Do collapse exhibit and catalogue grids at the established breakpoints rather than squeezing desktop arrangements on mobile.
donts: Don't introduce ambient shadows or heavy card chrome into the standard catalogue grid.
Don't turn the documentation surface into a permanent dark or sage field; expression belongs in bounded demos and exhibits.
Don't use rounded decorative blobs as a substitute for the system's restrained rectangle, pill, and hairline language.
Don't replace real component states with inert showcase controls; the live exhibit and registry both depend on working interaction.
